title: Label layout, version 1
description: A Retail Label Layout record: a label stock and its HTML template, filled by the till on the server (placeholders from a closed list, never code) and printed through the device's own print dialog (kind html), or Zebra printer commands sent to a counter till's own label printer (kind zpl). Judged by business_logic/label_print.py validate_layout when the record is saved. Page: docs/extending/label_layout.md.

declaration.description: Sizes in millimetres. The template holds only the listed placeholders, and the markup the template.allOf/1 pattern refuses never.

template.description: HTML. Placeholders: {item_code} {item_name} {barcode} {barcode_svg} {price} {currency} {uom} {batch_no} {expiry_date} {manufacturing_date} {weight} {unit_price} {store}. No script, frame, form, object, embed, link, meta or base tag, no javascript: and no on…= handler (the product also reads the template with HTML entities decoded and tab / CR / LF removed). A zpl template starts with ^XA and ends with ^XZ, and draws its barcode with the printer's own barcode command over {barcode}, never {barcode_svg} (the record checks it; the schema cannot say it).
